fields.summary_ko.0: Needham & Company's Scott Berg set a $150 target price for Anthropic (ANT), implying approximately 72% upside from current price, corresponding to a market cap of approximately $2 trillion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Anthropic's Q3 revenue surged 1,127% year-over-year to $1.7B, with monthly revenue reaching $8.1B as of end-October (up $1B in just one month), serving approximately 40 million users and over 1,900 customers spending $1 million or more.
fields.summary_ko.2: If Anthropic posts 2027 revenue of $11.5B or more, the P/S ratio at a year-end share price of $150 would be approximately 17.3x, with productivity improvements through Claude AI tool embedding enabling cost savings and profitability conversion.
